coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (phase 0/1) precision-medicine trial. Coded as C13 unspecified approved-drug panel. 'FDA-approved drugs that have been used in treating gliomas' may include established GBM therapies (temozolomide, lomustine, bevacizumab), so the panel could be established-therapy-only; not resolvable from the record. Genomic sequencing/PTC screening guides individual drug choice but is not an entry selection by a defined biomarker; coded exploratory_correlative. cns5 historical because WHO grade IV glioma named without IDH requirement.
